Invoice correction process allows user to correct already generated standard invoice. if billing data was incorrect or price settings - such kind of problems will be solved by this problem. Old invoice will stay unchanged and valid for accounting and also new invoices (debit/credit) will be generated after recalculation.

Invoice correction process can be started only for product and service contract invoices and has three main flow:

  • Invoice full correction

  • Invoice partial correction

  • Correction flow - only for scales

Detailed process flow: https://app.diagrams.net/#G1qxU03Qc3V6mu-ltb1LmvrcEG7172gkIQ#{"pageId"%3A"E-TLkJGicQyXzTt-2Kmp"}

Flow 1: - Invoice full correction

  • Flow is applicable for product /service contract

  • This flow allows user to recalculate invocie when price is changed. for old standard invoice will be created reversal invoice and then recalculated

    • before creating reversal invoice in system should be searched all connected debit/credit notes and to reverse all of them

    • reversal invoice means to create opposite document. For invoice and for debit note create credit note, for credit note create debit note

    • After creating reversal invoices should start standard billing process with predefined parameters for each process

  • For Product contract should be started standard billing process with listed parameters and as a result should be recalculated billing data and new correction debit/credit note should be generated

Parameters for product contract standard billing

Description

Contract number

Contract for which standard billing should be started

POD identifier or billing group

  1. if old invoice is created for billing group (separate invocie for PODs checkbox wasn’t checked) standard process should be started for this billing group and should use all PODs from current (correction billing run start date) billing group settings.

    1. if currently(correction billing run start date) separate invoice for PODs checkbox is checked - should return an error

  2. if old invoice is created for POD (separate invocie for PODs checkbox was checked) then standard billing should be started only for this POD.

    1. if currently separate invoice for PODs checkbox isn’t checked - should return an error

Price component setting (invoice1-invoice4)

from old invoice should be taken invoice setting (defined in price component invoice1-invoice4) and standard billing should run for all price components which has same invoice1-invocie4 setting at the moment of correction billing run start date.

Group of price components

When the correction billing run starts standard billing for recalculation, the system must resolve each Group of price components on the contract to the version whose price component settings apply to the contract version for the billing period taken from the original invoice billing data. All price components defined in that resolved group version must be calculated and included in generated correction documents (including ЕДИ), including price components with Data by scales, regardless of whether the correction billing run is started with Volume change only, Price change only, or both.

Billing data by profile/scale IDs

from old invoice and also from correction debit/credit notes should be taken all billing data by profile/scales IDs and recalculation standard process should be started including this IDs

Application model types  

from old invoice take application model types and start standard process only for those billing run types (e.g. run only for volumes and periodical which was in old invoice)

Date range for correction invoice

from old invoice take min and max dates

  • For Service contract should be started standard billing process with listed parameters and as a result should be generated new correction debit/credit note should

Parameters for service contract standard billing

Description

Contract number/version

Contract for which standard billing should be started. process should use service contract version which is at the moment of correction billing run start date.

Price component setting (invoice1-invoice4)

from old invoice should be taken invoice setting (defined in price component invoice1-invoice4) and standard billing should run for all price components which has same invoice1-invocie4 setting at the moment of correction billing run start date.

Application model types  

from old invoice take application model types and start standard process only for those billing run types (e.g. run only for per piece and periodical which was in old invoice)

Invoice partial correction

  • Flow is applicable only for product contract

  • Flow allows to start correction process only for PODs for which new billing data by profiles/by scales are received.. (if only billing data by scales - correction are received should be started 3rd flow); And for other PODs in invoice shouldn’t be calculated anything . For filtering billing data should be used period range defined in old invoice. So, reversal invoices will be generated only for PODs for which new billing data is received

    • before creating reversal invoice in system should be searched all connected debit/credit notes and to reverse all of them only for those PODs

    • reversal invoice means to create opposite document. For invoice and for debit note create credit note, for credit note create debit note

    • After creating reversal invoices should start standard billing process with predefined parameters for each process and new correction debit/credit note should be generated

Parameters for product contract standard billing

Description

Contract number

Contract for which standard billing should be started

POD identifiers

  1. POD identifiers for which new billing data was received. Its possible for one invoice for some PODs to start 2nd flow and for others to start 3rd flow

Price component setting (invoice1-invoice4)

from old invoice should be taken invoice setting (defined in price component invoice1-invoice4) and standard billing should run for all price components which has same invoice1-invocie4 setting at the moment of correction billing run start date.

Group of price components

When the correction billing run starts standard billing for recalculation, the system must resolve each Group of price components on the contract to the version whose price component settings apply to the contract version for the billing period taken from the original invoice billing data. All price components defined in that resolved group version must be calculated and included in generated correction documents (including ЕДИ), including price components with Data by scales, regardless of whether the correction billing run is started with Volume change only, Price change only, or both.

Billing data by profile/scale IDs

from old invoice and also from correction debit/credit notes should be taken all billing data by profile/scales IDs and recalculation standard process should be started including this IDs

Application model type - volumes

start standard process only volumes

Date range for correction invoice

from old invoice take min and max dates

Correction flow - only for scales

  • Flow is applicable only for product contract

  • Flow should be started when only billing data by scales - correction type records is received for POD.

    • Its possible to receive only scales record considering some conditions to switch to partial invoicing flow

  • In correction flow - only for scales reversal invoices shouldn’t be created and newly received billing data should be calculated and generated as a debit/credit note

Note:

  • Standard billings which will be started from correction flow should skip interim deduction process

  • Only from 3rd flow - Correction for scales should be ignored restriction process

Questions:

  • accounting period should be same or from billing run?

  • how to calculate payment term for corrected liability?
